extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers (novice to intermediate) seeking plot and structure craft guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Practical techniques and exercises for creating and revising plot and story structure that grip readers, using the LOCK system and genre-appropriate story models. Includes diagrams, checklists, examples, and troubleshooting tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: LOCK system (Lead, Objective, Confrontation, Knockout)
rubrics_metrics.description: A four-part system for understanding and building plot: Lead, Objective, Confrontation, and Knockout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From chapter 1, 'What is Plot, Anyway?': find out what plot is, how it works, and learn the LOCK system: Lead, Objective, Confrontation, and Knockout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Lead' element of the LOCK system (the hook/initial impetus that starts the plot).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as the first element of the LOCK system; used to establish the story's initial spark or inciting force (page advertises learning this in chapter 1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Objective' element of the LOCK system (the character's goal that drives the plot).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named as the second element of LOCK; implies plotting around a clear, motivating objective for characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confrontation
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Confrontation' element of the LOCK system (obstacles, conflict and escalation that challenge the objective).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named as the third element of LOCK; emphasizes conflict as the engine of plot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Knockout
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Knockout' element of the LOCK system (the payoff, climax, or resolution of the plot).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named as the fourth element of LOCK; implies a satisfying culminating event or resolution that lands the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong Beginnings
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for crafting effective openings that engage readers and start the plot cleanly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page promises 'Techniques for crafting strong beginnings'—focus on openings that grip readers and establish the Lead/Objective quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong Middles
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods for constructing the middle of a story to sustain momentum and develop conflict.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists 'middles' explicitly: guidance covers how to keep escalation, complications, and pacing effective between opening and climax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong Ends
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies for delivering satisfying endings that resolve the plot and deliver impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page promises 'ends' techniques—crafting climaxes and resolutions (Knockout) that feel earned and memorable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of plotting diagrams and charts
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ easy-to-understand diagrams and charts to map plot beats and structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book includes 'easy-to-understand plotting diagrams and charts' as tools to visualize structure and plan story flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brainstorming for original plot ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques to generate fresh, original plot concepts during early development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page advertises 'Brainstorming techniques for original plot ideas'—practical methods to invent or twist premises and beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thought-provoking exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: Hands-on exercises at the end of each chapter to practice techniques and develop plots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book contains 'thought-provoking exercises at the end of each chapter' to reinforce learning through practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story structure models and methods for all genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply story-structure models and methods adapted for different genres and conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page states 'Story structure models and methods for all genres'—guidance on selecting and tailoring structure to genre expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tips and tools for correcting common plot problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Diagnostic techniques and corrective strategies for revising plot or structure when things go off course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promised 'Tips and tools for correcting common plot problems'—practical revision aids to fix weaknesses in pacing, motivation, or logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study plot examples from popular novels
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn from concrete plot examples drawn from published novels to see techniques in action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book is 'filled with plot examples from popular novels'—use exemplars to understand application of principles and patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive checklists
rubrics_metrics.description: Use checklists to verify plot and structural elements are present and effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book includes 'comprehensive checklists'—practical lists to ensure key beats, motivations, and structural necessities are addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical, hands-on guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Actionable, pragmatic advice for approaching plot and structure like an experienced pro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as 'practical hands-on guidance'—emphasis on usable techniques rather than only theory.
